youtube.title: How to Close More Estimates When They Say "Let Me Think About It"
youtube.description:
How to close more estimates when they say "let me think about it": ask before you leave.
For plumbing, HVAC, electrical and home service business owners.
ServiceTitan, "The Profile of a Top Performer: Four Behaviors That Set the Top 10% of Contractors Apart" (May 19, 2026): top performers (contractors in the 90th percentile of revenue within their trade and market segment) close 77% of their estimates during the same visit; for the rest, 62%. The 15-point gap comes down to momentum. Aggregated, anonymized data from participating ServiceTitan customers across HVAC, plumbing, electrical, garage door, water treatment and other specialty trades, trailing 12 months through January 2026. ServiceTitan says these behaviors are correlated with higher performance and do not show a cause.

Say this before you leave:
1. "Here are your options."
2. "If you want to go ahead today, I can get you on the schedule for [day]."
3. "What questions do you have before you pick one?"

That last question pulls the worry out while you're still there to answer it. Send this to whoever runs your estimates.
